local me = Game.GetLocalPlayer()
local pInfluence = Players[me]:GetInfluence()
if pInfluence:GetTokensToGive() <= 0 then print("ERR:NO_ENVOYS|No envoy tokens available"); print("---END---"); return end
if not pInfluence:CanGiveTokensToPlayer(7) then
    print("ERR:CANNOT_SEND|Cannot send envoy to player 7"); print("---END---"); return
end
local params = {}
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_PLAYER_ONE] = 7
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_FLAGS] = 0
UI.RequestPlayerOperation(me, PlayerOperations.GIVE_INFLUENCE_TOKEN, params)
local cfg = PlayerConfigurations[7]
local name = cfg and Locale.Lookup(cfg:GetPlayerName()) or "Unknown"
print("OK:ENVOY_SENT|" .. name)
print("---END---")
